# okfctl

> okfctl is a command-line tool that writes and checks Open Knowledge Format
> (OKF) bundles: folders of linked Markdown files with YAML frontmatter. Pure
> Go, runs offline.

`okfctl node mv` renames a node and rewrites each link that pointed at it.
`okfctl validate` exits 1 if a bundle breaks the OKF spec floor (frontmatter
that doesn't parse is one example). `okfctl lint --strict` exits 1 on any
curation finding, like a node that names another with no link to it.
`okfctl migrate` upgrades v0.1 and v0.2 bundles to OKF v0.3 and writes what it
won't guess to a plan file. okfctl follows the OKF spec and adds no rules of
its own. Checks stricter than the spec, like `validate --templates`, are
opt-in.

## Docs

- [Command reference](https://okfctl.dev/reference/commands/): All commands and flags, each with an example, generated from the binary's help text.
- [Concepts](https://okfctl.dev/concepts/): Bundles, nodes, the link graph, plus the reserved `index.md` and `log.md` files.
- [Authoring a bundle](https://okfctl.dev/guides/authoring/): From an empty directory to a bundle that passes `validate`.
- [Curation health](https://okfctl.dev/guides/curation-health/): `lint`, `analyze`, and `--strict` in CI.
- [Migrating to OKF v0.3](https://okfctl.dev/guides/migrating/): `migrate` plan, dry-run, then apply, for v0.1 and v0.2 bundles.

## Specification

- [Open Knowledge Format spec (SPEC.md)](https://github.com/open-knowledge-format/open-knowledge-format/blob/main/SPEC.md): The OKF specification, v0.3, in `open-knowledge-format/open-knowledge-format`. The older `GoogleCloudPlatform/open-knowledge-format` repo is deprecated and frozen at v0.2. Where the spec defines behavior, okfctl follows the spec.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/cwest/okfctl): Source, releases, issues.
